MALCOLM ki khun shyntang jong u.
DONALBAIN MACBETH ki jernel jong ka kynhun shipai Syiem.
: BANQUO MACDUFF LENNOX ROSS MENTEITH ki Bakhraw.batri ka Scotland.
ANGUS CAITHNESS FLEANCE, u khin u Banquo.
SIWARD, u Bakhraw ka Northumberland, u jernel ki pyrton shipai Phareng.
SIWARD samla, u khun jong u.
SEYTON, u rangbah ncngialam uba hajir ha u Macbeth.
--- Page 6 --- U khynnah, u khun u Macduff.
U Doktor Phareng jong u Syiem Bilat.
Doktor Scotland jong u Macbeth.
U Sorjon.
U Shipai.
U Nongap khyrdop.
U Tymmen.
Lai ngut ki nongpyniap-briew.
KA LADY MACBETH KA LADY MACDUFF, Ka theidonburom ba hajir ha'ka Ladv Macbeth HEcATE, ka blei-jadu-myntot.
Lai ngut ki thei jadu.
Ki jingpyni rngai.
Ki Lyngskor, ki riewdonburom, ki rangbah nongialam, ki shipai, ki Nongbud-nongrap, bad ki Nonglamktien Nonglamkhubor.
Ki jaka pyni :--Scotland : England.
--- Page 7 --- KI KYNTHUP.
AKT I Jingpyni i.
Ka jingiakynduh ia ki lai ngut ki thei jadu.
Jingpyni i.
Ka jingiathuh.thma u serjon ba phlei snam.
Jingpyni ii.
Ki jingkren kunok khublei ki thei-jadu la pyndep shiteng shiliang da ka jingwaniashem u Ross bad u Angus.
Jingpyni iv.
Ka jingiaroh sngewnguh na u Syiem sha u Macbeth, Jingpyni v.
U,, Macbeth u pyntip ia ka khubor babha sha la ka tnga bad wan iashem bad ka.
Jingpyni vi.
,Ka jingwan, u, Syiem sha ka iingpaki dulan u Macbeth.
Jngpyni vi, ,Hamar, ka bam jamiet u Mfac.
beth bad ka tnga ki dang iapyrkhat pyniap.
AKT Jingpyni.
U Macbeth ha ka lynti jong u sha ka jingpyniap.
Jingpyni ii la ka kam pyniap briew la pyndep.
Jingpyni iii.
Ka jinglait khubor la ka jing.
pyniap lyngba, u, Macduff Lennox, Banquo b bad Malcolm.
Jingpyni iv.
Ki dak sniew bapharshi lypa jong ka sahit bneng AKT III Jingpyni , i, Ka jingiakren hapdeng u Mac.
beth bad Banquo: ka jingpyrkhat pyniap.
Jingpyni i.
Ka jingiakren hapdeng u Mac.
beth bad ka Lady Macbeth.
Jingpyni ii.
Ka jingeyniap ia u Banquo.
--- Page 8 --- Jingpyni iv.
Ka jingiohi ha ka 'camra khawai- dawai.
Jingpyni V.
Ka jingpyai ba ha ka jaka kyn.
Ka j Jingpynivi.
jingiakren suba sniew ha- pdeng ki bakhraw-batri.
AKT IV Jingpyni i.
U Macbath hapoh ka krem jadu-myntor.

Jingpyni ii., Ka jingpyniap ia u khun bad ka ti ga u Macduff Jingpyni ii , Ka jingiakren hapdeng u Mal- colm bad Macduff, ha kaba la wanrab khubor shaphang, ka jingpyniap ia kiba iing jong u baroh kdar.
ATK V Jingoy i, i.
Ka Jingpyni ia ka jingiaid ruma samthiah joag ka Ladv Macbeth.
Jingpyni i.
Ka jingiakren lorni hapdeng ki Rangbah Bakhraw-batri.
Jingpvni ii, U Macbeth ha Dusinan bad u Seyton bad u Doktor.
Jingpyai iv Ka jingiaid thma u , Malcolm.
Jingpyni.
, Ka jingiap ka Lady Macbeth : ka jingkhih ka khlaw Birnam.
Jingpyni vi.
Ka jingpynkhreh ban ialeh.
ka jingialeh bad u Macbeth.
Jingpyaivii , la u Macbeth la pyniap bad ia U Maicolm la khreh pynphong pansngiat.

--- Page 9 --- Ka Jinglam Khmat Ka Scotland hi ka long ka ri kaba itynnat ba dap da ki lum mawsiang shatei jong kari England, ba la sait ia ki rud ryngkew jong ka da ka duriaw bashatei kaba pynsawa sngew.
tynnat ia ka jingphaloh um shapoh ki krem ki kroh jong ki synrang mawsiang jong ka.
Ka don de ka jingiabteng ter ter ki kyntoit lum ba.

iakiew iahiar padin padin ba pynithiang ia ki khmat ki nongpeit ba la pynsriem ia ka madan Golflink ka sor Shillong, ba kumta la tip ia ka Shillong kum ka "Scotland of the East' ha ka thain Mihngi beroh kawei.

Ka don de ki pung ba kum ki nan ti Khasi ba iabteng pateng pateng., ha kaba la, king ki lieng na shiliang sha shiliang jong ki ba-isriem dur ia ka "Dam Site" ka sor Shillong, kat ban pynkylla donnam ia u Sir Walter Scott uba thoh poetry shaphang jong ki, bad kat haduh ban pynriew.
spah pat ia ki briew sha kito ki thain na ka jingialeit iawan eh ki briew sha kito ki jaka shato ban khmih pyrthei ia ka jingithiang jong ki.

Ha ka de don ki riewialehthma kiba shyrkhei ha ka jingialehthma khap pud jong ki ban pynmih ki myllung bad ki nongrwai pt awar bapynkhluit mynsiem ia ki nongshongshnong bad'ki trai ri kato ka thain., Ka jingsawa ka jingriew ki waitlam baiatyngkhuh ka jingthaba ki wait ba iakalain had ka jingiathom riap-riap ha ka jingialeh ka pynsngew ia ki-nongpeit bad nongsngap la kum ba riew ki pyrthat phria, ba ba ki leilieh bad babeh ka eriong-erngit ki nai laiong ka thain Sohra bad Mawsynrim.
